text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Canary cluster eu-west-1: 5xx rate spike on /generate (p95 latency also increasing). Metric: canary/generation/5xx_rate = 12% (5m) > threshold. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/canary/eu-west-1

marta: On it, pulled logs. Seeing repeated OOM-ish reallocs in the runtime: `allocator: failed to reserve 32MB` across several pods. Looks tied to recent prefetch topology change (prefetch_topo_v2).

sam: Repro on a canary pod locally w/ same config. Prefetch seems to grow unbounded for certain long prompts.

marta: Rolling the canary back to previous flag state now. Flipping feature flag `prefetch_topo_v2` -> off via /flags service.

ops-bot: Flag toggle recorded: prefetch_topo_v2 set to false by marta at 2026-03-17T03:02:10Z.

marta: Applied quick kill-switch. Monitoring...

lee: Noted. Any customer-facing errors observed? ETA to know scope?

prod-support: From error-tracking: 17 customers affected (mostly EU), spike started ~03:00Z, 5xxs were 502/503 gateway errors. Logged errors from downstream LB: `upstream read timeout` + `connection reset`. We've opened a customer ticket list.

sam: I have a one-line hotfix that reverts a perf regression in the prefetch allocator (single commit revert). Can push to canary as a small patch to validate before full rollback.

marta: Prefer a revert of the commit instead of a multi-config rollout. Do the canary patch, test, then roll-forward if green.

sam: Pushing quick revert to canary now. Command: ```git revert --no-edit abcdef1 && git push && ./deploy.sh --canary eu-west-1 --image=service:patch-prefetch-revert```

ops-bot: Deploy triggered: svc/generation canary eu-west-1 by sam. CI: pass.

sam: Canary is up. Running smoke: `curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer x' https://canary-eu.gen.internal/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'` -> 200, latency p95 ~120ms stable. Logs show allocator back to normal.

marta: Good. Start a staged rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 15m windows. Keep prefetch flag off during rollout.

lee: I'll watch infra metrics and SLO dashboard during rollout. If p95 or 5xx rises revert to previous image and re-enable kill-switch.

prod-support: Notifying affected customers that we mitigated and are rolling the patch. Draft message sent to customers group A/B for transparency.

ops-bot: Rollout plan executed: 10% -> 50% at 03:18Z.

marta: At 50% stage now. Observability: 5xx back down to baseline (~0.4%), p95 within normal. No error surge observed.

sam: Proceeding to 100% rollout. Command: ```./deploy.sh --rollout 100 --strategy=staged```

ops-bot: Rollout to 100% completed at 03:30Z.

lee: Post-rollout checks: healthchecks passing, memory usage normalized across pods, no OOMs seen in last 10m.

prod-support: Updated customer notifications: issue mitigated, root cause suspected memory growth in prefetch topology change; follow-up postmortem will be shared.

marta: Handoff to lee for overnight watch. Summary for oncall: incident triggered by prefetch_topo_v2 config; feature flag kill-switch and single-commit revert hotpatch restored stability. TODOs: create postmortem, add guardrails (max-prefetch cap), add alert rule for allocator growth.

lee: Ack. I'll own the postmortem doc and assign follow-ups. Setting task: `PMT-432` for guardrail work and `INF-987` for alert tuning.

sam: Leaving a note in the deployment changelog: reverted commit abcdef1; recommended follow-up: stress test prefetch with long prompt workloads.

marta: Thank you all. Closing pager. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Pager closed by marta at 03:44Z. Duration: 42m.
